THE SIMPLE TEST
  1. 01
    Subtract predicted tide

    Observed NOAA water level minus astronomical tide prediction.

  2. 02
    Apply a short rolling mean

    Choose 24, 48, or 72 hours to reduce high-frequency noise.

  3. 03
    Compare peak order

    Flag only a three-station northbound sequence within the broad speed band.

OPEN DATA, REPRODUCIBLE METHOD

Measured, not modeled.

The main chart calls NOAA’s public CO-OPS API in your browser whenever it loads. Missing or delayed records are surfaced rather than filled in. DART and satellite layers remain deliberately out of scope for this first pass.
